notes.title: Prepare for your next expedition
notes.content:
Ahoy Conquistadors! It’s time for your first exploration briefing: here’s how all your expeditions should go:

[h3]Create Your Group & Dive into the Action[/h3]

Whether you’re teaming up with friends or matching with fellow adventurers, forming your party is the first step to survival. Grab your crew and get ready to face the horrors of the jungle together!

[h3]Visit the Galleon - Equip Yourself for the Fight[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/d482a1f8f9fd6b00de6717617141c3425ed00a2e.png[/img]
Before setting out, head to the Galleon (aka your last bastion of sanity before the unknown) where you can purchase equipment, weapons, and gear up. This is where you will have to choose in which expedition you want to participate, even if they’re all leading to a new nightmare. Get the right equipment to face the challenges that await! But remember: survival isn’t always about firepower.

[h3]Explore, Survive & Loot the Jungle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/249aa76790afec0ed35e6fa66bd26d4a03d95fd6.png[/img]
The deeper you go, the more the jungle changes. As you venture into it, you’ll need to escort your ox cart, scavenge valuable loot such as forbidden relics, and survive against the growing threats. As the environment itself reacts to your presence and plays with your mind, every decision counts, and every encounter could be your last. 

In The Mound, is surviving the real victory, or is it about fulfilling the captain’s contract? Is it enough to make it out alive, or should the cart be filled to the brim to prove true success? In the jungle, [b]what’s truly worth more—your life, or your loot?[/b]

[h3]End of the Run - Evaluate Your Loot & Achievements[/h3]

Once your adventure concludes, take a moment to assess your haul. Did you gather enough treasure to fulfil your contract? What new achievements have you unlocked? Prepare for the next expedition, as each new journey brings new surprises!

The most important thing to remember is that each expedition brings you closer to the Mound—[b]if you’re willing to pay the price[/b] 🪙🧠

notes.title: Be welcomed Conquistadors !
notes.content:
We’re excited to share our upcoming Lovecraftian horror co-op game developed by ACE Team. Prepare for your future exploration, in order to discover what The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu has to offer for the bravest among you.

[previewyoutube=sRDCm5f1zxc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]About The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu: [/h3]

The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu is a co-op horror game inspired by the H.P. Lovecraft’s novel, where you will be given the chance to find the Mound and its great treasures. To succeed in this mission, you will be able to form a group made up of up to 4 players to safely escort your ox wagon across a 1600’s cursed jungle. Be careful, what you will endure may affect your sanity, triggering events that could cause troubles for your squad…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/a6664dac7b406bef7db958fdabedb7d2bb1a27b3.png[/img]
[h3]About Ace Team: [/h3]

ACE Team has been founded by 3 brothers: Andres, Carlos and Edmundo Bordeu. Their studio is based in Santiago, Chile and has over a decade of experience in the games industry and is one of the leading game developers from Latin America. The studio is internationally acclaimed for its unique titles which have achieved several notable industry awards around the world, such as Clash: Artifact of Chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/d482a1f8f9fd6b00de6717617141c3425ed00a2e.png[/img]
[h3]Join the Galleon:[/h3]

Of course we will share more details about the game, that is why we invite you to join our official Discord server! 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/FM3cZacJT7 style=button]Discord[/url]

ACE Team aims to continue innovating and developing ambitious IPs in the core industry.
While you wait for more news about this upcoming adventure, you can [b]Wishlist The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu on Steam now[/b]: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2569760/The_Mound_Omen_of_Cthulhu/
